result.summary: The page is generally polished, but the fixed bottom navigation visibly obscures the next restaurant card and the horizontal carousels end in abruptly clipped items at the right edge.

issues.description: The fixed bottom navigation covers the lower portion of the second restaurant card, leaving its image and content visibly cut off at the bottom of the viewport.
issues.suggestion: Add bottom padding to the scrollable page content equal to the navigation bar height plus safe-area spacing, or ensure the card cannot sit behind the fixed navigation.

issues.description: The category row and the 'Fastest near you' restaurant carousel show partially clipped items at the right edge. This may be intentional for horizontal scrolling, but there is no visible scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Confirm that these rows are horizontally scrollable and add a subtle scroll cue or adjust spacing if the partial items are not intentional.
